description: This file defines a React component 'TabbedUserModal' that displays user details and associated projects within a modal dialog. It includes subcomponents for rendering user details and projects, and manages tab switching between these views. It also imports external UI components and hooks.

methods.name: UserDetailsView
methods.description: A React functional component that displays user details such as name, email, department, and tenant in a styled grid.

methods.name: UserProjectsView
methods.description: A React functional component that fetches and displays a list of projects associated with a user, with loading and error handling.

methods.name: TabbedUserModal
methods.description: Main React component that renders a modal with tabs for user details and projects, managing state and tab switching.
